title: Decentralisation and Balanced Development
grammar: How Sure Is the Judgement? egyértelműen, vitathatatlanul
goal: I can describe what decentralisation and a balanced spatial structure mean.
I can mark how sure a judgement is with *egyértelműen* and *vitathatatlanul*, and say whose it is.
I can say that a proposal about decentralisation is someone's view.
